questions.prompt: Write a text leaving the family group chat dramatically. Under 25 words.
questions.answer: I entered this chat as family. I leave as a legend. Do not add me back. This is my final curtain.

questions.prompt: Convince me to skip the gym today. Under 25 words.
questions.answer: It's nearly midnight on Sunday. Your muscles grow during rest, not reps. Sleep now, then crush Monday's session fully charged.

questions.prompt: Write a toxic motivational quote. Under 20 words.
questions.answer: Nobody is coming to save you. Stay stuck or become someone your excuses can’t recognize.

questions.prompt: Reply to someone who owes you money but just posted vacation photos. Under 25 words.
questions.answer: Great photos! Glad you’re enjoying the trip. Since you clearly have the funds, when can I expect that money you owe me?

questions.prompt: Write a one star review of Monday. Under 30 words
questions.answer:
★☆☆☆☆
Arrived completely uninvited just as the weekend was getting good. Brought loud alarms, endless emails, and terrible vibes. I’d like a refund. Skip if possible.
